caption: The drawing features three bonnet illustrations arranged in a loose triangular composition on a plain, light background. In the upper right quadrant, there is a prominently detailed rendering of a large bonnet in shades of grey and beige, with a rounded crown, stiff front brim, and long, flowing, translucent beige ribbons hanging down. In the lower left quadrant, there is another bonnet, drawn with thin, careful lines and shaded in light browns and creams, emphasizing the fabric folds and stitching; this bonnet has a gathered crown and a soft brim, without ribbons. In the upper left quadrant, there is a faint, lightly sketched outline of another bonnet, similar in shape to the others but with minimal detail and shading, appearing almost as a preparatory sketch. The composition presents the bonnets individually spaced from each other, with the artist’s name “LILIAN CALKIN” written in small capital letters near the lower right.
title: Quaker Bonnet
